name: healthcare
description: A clinic patient management system. Actions that touch patient care or disclose protected health information are policy-sensitive.

tools.name: search_patients
tools.description: Search patients by name, date of birth, or insurance id. Read-only.

dob.description: Optional: date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD to narrow results.

tools.name: get_patient
tools.description: Fetch a single patient profile by exact patient id. Read-only.

tools.name: read_record
tools.description: Read the full contents of a medical record by its exact record id. Read-only.

tools.name: get_record_metadata
tools.description: Fetch metadata for a medical record, such as author, last updated date, and page count, without its contents. Read-only.

tools.name: search_appointments
tools.description: Search appointments by patient, date range, or status. Read-only.

tools.name: get_appointment
tools.description: Fetch a single appointment by its exact appointment id. Read-only.

tools.name: schedule_appointment
tools.description: Create a new appointment for a patient.

tools.name: cancel_appointment
tools.description: Cancel an existing appointment. This is final and notifies the patient; only call once the cancellation has been verified against the appointment on file, not on a verbal say-so alone.

tools.name: verify_identity
tools.description: Verify a caller's or requester's identity against records on file before any sensitive disclosure or action. Read-only.

method.description: Optional: how identity was checked, e.g. date_of_birth, id_document, callback.

tools.name: share_record
tools.description: Disclose a medical record to a named recipient outside the care team. This is a permanent PHI disclosure and cannot be undone; only call once the recipient's right to receive the record has been verified.

recipient.description: Name or email of who receives the record.

tools.name: prescribe_medication
tools.description: Create a new prescription for a patient. This is a clinical action with a real-world effect; only call on explicit clinician instruction with the patient and medication confirmed.
